TRANSACTIONS AND USE TAX CITIZENS'
  ADVISORY COMMITTEE AGENDA
  THURSDAY, JUNE 4, 2026
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 3:30 PM

Rolando Cruz, Chair  Uduak-Joe Ntuk, Member
Jan Hower, Vice Chair  David Ochoa, Member
Robert Emigh, Member

  Members of the public have the option to submit online and email public comments to
  CityClerk@longbeach.gov

  To view the meeting from your computer, tablet, or smartphone
  visit: https://longbeach.primegov.com/public/portal?fromiframe=true

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-55185  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Transactions and Use Tax
  Citizens’ Advisory Committee meeting of Thursday, April 2, 2026.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-55198  Recommendation to receive and file an update on the Long Beach Police
  Department’s use of Measure A funding.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  26-55199  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation from the Office of the City
  Attorney regarding the Brown Act and Robert’s Rules of Order.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  26-55200  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation from the Office of Ethics and
  Transparency regarding updates to the Ethics program.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  26-55201  Recommendation to receive and file a report from current Ad Hoc Committee;
  discuss anticipated Ad Hoc Committees for upcoming projects; and, if appropriate,
  take action to dissolve or create Ad Hoc Committees.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.
